reason: Code mistake found in review: a derived Q4 (fiscal year minus nine-month YTD) paired the year as first filed in the 10-K with the latest-known nine months, which can be a recast filed later (a comparative in next year's 10-Q), mixing two bases. Example: CAT Q4 2015 ProfitLoss came out -500M. Across the broad universe at three views, 129 of 9,050 derived Q4 NetIncomeLoss values change and 83 without a nine-month figure known at the 10-K are dropped. Fixed in metrics._quarters_of (the nine months as known when the year was filed); re-declared as H3c-earnings_yield_ttm.

Code mistake found in review: events.distinct treated every 8-K item 2.02 filing within 20 days of the previous filing as the same release, so results that followed a pre-announcement or preliminary revenue release were dropped (NVDA 2019-02-15 after 2019-01-28; ISRG's January results each year; CAT 2024-10-30), and the signal took the earlier filing's reaction. In the broad universe it kept 62,455 of 66,445 filings; the fix (a re-file within a day or an 8-K/A within 20 days is the same release, compared with the last release kept) keeps 65,253. Re-declared as H7b-earnings_reaction.

Code mistake found in review: SUE's quarterly EPS used the derived Q4 that paired the fiscal year as first filed with a nine-month YTD recast later (see H3b's withdrawal). Fixed in metrics._quarters_of; re-declared as H8b-sue.
